links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, FRE) of LLM answers to patient questions
links.effect: FKGL 9.71 (ChatGPT) vs 11.43 (Gemini), p=0.002; FRE 46.53 vs 43.70, p=0.243. Both outputs above a plain-language level.
links.quote: ChatGPT produced more readable outputs (FRE: 46.53 vs 43.70, p = 0.243; FKGL: 9.71 vs 11.43, p = 0.002), indicating approximately two US grade levels of easier reading.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the quality and readability of two LLMs (ChatGPT and Gemini) answering patient FAQs on augmentation mammaplasty, assessed by clinical raters and readability metrics.
